title: Inverse-image cohomology composition
statement: Let f:Y→X and g:Z→Y be scheme morphisms and F any abelian sheaf on X. For any n≥0 and x∈H^n(X,F), first apply the inverse-image cohomology maps for f and g with their specified constant integer comparisons [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison], then apply H.map of invImageComp(g,f) at F [lem-pc-coefficient-unit-composition]. The result is the inverse-image cohomology map for g followed by f with its specified constant comparison, applied to x. No coefficient, structure-sheaf, scalar or cartesian assumptions occur.

proof.text: The comparison for the constant integer sheaf along g followed by f agrees with the comparison for g followed by inverseImage(g) of the comparison for f and invImageComp(g,f) at the constant sheaf. Under the composite constant-sections and inverse-image adjunctions both are adjoint to the same sections map; injectivity of the hom equivalence proves coherence.

Expand Sheaf.H.mapFunctor as precomposition by the inverse constant comparison and exact-functor action on Ext. Use exactFunctorCompositionComparison for the natural isomorphism invImageComp, Ext.mapExactFunctor_comp and Ext.mapExactFunctor_mk₀ to move the degree-zero source and target comparisons through the two exact-functor actions. Ext composition associativity, cancellation of the comparison isomorphisms and the constant coherence identity identify the two classes. Works for identities, all degrees and zero sheaves.

lean.statement:
theorem inverseImageCohomology_comp {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (n : ℕ) (x : F.H n) :
    Sheaf.H.map ((invImageComp g f).hom.app F) n
        (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage g) (constIso g).symm ((invImage f).obj F) n
          (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage f) (constIso f).symm F n x)) =
      Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (invImage (g ≫ f)) (constIso (g ≫ f)).symm F n x
